newsitem.title: USA: Dave & Busters to open four units in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Dave & Busters to open four units in 1998.

text.p: Dave & Busters Inc said Wednesday it plans to open four stores in 1998 and four additional units in 1999.
From the year 2000 onward, the chain plans to open five a year, David Corriveau, co-founder, told the Piper Jaffray investor conference here.
Dave & Busters now has 10 restaurant-entertainment complexes in the United States and one in the United Kingdom. Corriveau said the company hopes to have seven in the United Kingdom by the year 2000.
